comment: Every ceiling of docs/WAVE-D.md §7 (d1a). Bytes for build rows (KB = 1000 B); µs, MiB, KiB, ms or ratios for runtime rows as named. Build-time rows stay report-only (enforce: false) until they are rebased on baseline-1's release dist (D26; open: needs d2a's release build measured). bench/compare.mjs reads the runtime rows; frontend/scripts/postbuild.mjs the build rows.

BB1.what: app startup set JS + CSS, gzip

BB2.what: app startup set JS + CSS, brotli

BB3.what: engine host's own startup JS, gzip

BB5a.what: blocker chunk and its builder Worker, raw, each

BB9.what: gnome-server stripped static musl, x86_64 and aarch64, each

BB10.what: gnome-server image per architecture, compressed / uncompressed

BB12.what: crates in cargo tree -p gnome-server -e normal (recorded)

RB2.what: gnome-server RSS after H1 (a) c=64, MiB

RB3.what: gnome-server RSS growth per idle Wisp connection (W4 slope), KiB

RB5.what: W1 1x10 through the gateway / HolyWisp direct

RB6.what: W2 idle latency added by the gateway over HolyWisp direct, µs

RB7.what: W3 (a) Wisp setup p99 through the gateway, µs

RB8.what: H1 (a) c=64 req/s rust / node4 (min) and p99 at 5000 req/s (µs)

RB9.what: A1 ticket mint p99 at 2000 req/s, µs

RB10.what: S1 startup p50 (a) warm / (b) cold / (c) fresh, ms
